protocol: Same output_ral/B reconstructions (full ScanNet sequence, SAM3 masks, per-crop CLIP features). Label-bound uses the stored SAM3 class name (0 post-hoc queries per instance). Post-hoc is one argmax of that crop feature against the 200 ScanNet200 CLIP text embeddings. This is not an OVI-MAP reconstruction and not OVI-MAP's published view-query count.
